We evaluate the quality of the generated dataset (Section 4.2) and the dialogue model fine-tuned with it (Section 4.3). We compare our dataset with CounselGPT<sup>7</sup>, the only Korean counseling dataset to date that is created using OpenAI API, and AnnoMI. We translate AnnoMI into Korean using Up

stage SOLAR (Kim et al., 2024) translation $\mathsf{API}^8$ , in order to evaluate it in the context of Korean.

Fine-tuning Details We fine-tune the komt-llama2-7b-v1 model for KMI, CounselGPT, and AnnoMI by using 3 NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs with 40GB memory. Table 16 illustrates hyperparameters for fine-tuning the dialogue models. We use AdamW for optimization. Table 16: Hyperparameters for fine-tuning the dialogue models.
HyperparameterValue
Epochs3
Learning Rate1e-6
Batch Size16
Max. Sequence Length2,048
